rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 15 March 1990, after the constitutional oath, the President of the National Congress, Senator Nelson Carneiro, declared Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello and Itamar Augusto Cautiero Franco invested ('empossados') as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 15 March 1990 to 1 January 1995.

locator.item: O SR. PRESIDENTE (Nelson Carneiro) - Declaro empossados ...

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse read and signed at the session records that at 10:00 on 15 March 1990, before the National Congress in joint session in the Chamber's plenary, Collor and Itamar Franco were solemnly invested under Article 78 of the Constitution in the offices of President and Vice-President for the period from 15 March 1990 to 1 January 1995, and took the prescribed oath.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address to the joint session of 15 March 1990 Fernando Collor brings to the Legislative Power, before which, following the Constitution, he 'acabo de assumir a Presidência da República' (has just assumed the Presidency of the Republic), his esteem and homage.

locator.item: Collor's address: 'Venho trazer ao Poder Legislativo, ante o qual, seguindo o preceito da Constituição, acabo de assumir a Presidência da República'

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The same termo recites that they had been elected in the second round on 17 December of the previous year and certified ('diplomados') by the Superior Electoral Court on 30 December of that year.

locator.item: Termo de posse, 'diplomados, pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, a trinta de dezembro do mesmo ano'

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The session was opened to give posse to the President and Vice-President elected in the second round on 17 December 1989 and certified by the TSE for the period 15 March 1990 to 1 January 1995.

locator.item: opening statement of the President of Congress

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Opening the solemn joint session of 15 March 1990, the President of Congress, Senator Nelson Carneiro, stated that it was convened to give posse to the President and Vice-President of the Republic elected in the second round on 17 December 1989 and certified ('diplomados') by the Superior Electoral Court for the period 15 March 1990 to 1 January 1995, naming Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello and Itamar Augusto Cautiero Franco.

locator.item: O SR. PRESIDENTE (Nelson Carneiro) - Declaro aberta a sessão solene ... destinada a dar posse ao Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the session resumed (suspended 9:43-9:46), the President and the Vice-President-elect were seated at the Mesa, the Vice-President to the left of the President of the Senate, and both took the constitutional oath ('Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição ...') before the joint session.

locator.item: 'Os Srs. Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República irão prestar o compromisso constitucional'; the oath text continues on printed page 302

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the oath, the President of Congress declared Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello and Itamar Augusto Cautiero Franco invested ('Declaro empossados') as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 15 March 1990 to 1 January 1995.

locator.item: O SR. PRESIDENTE (Nelson Carneiro) - Declaro empossados, para o período de 15 de março de 1990 a 1º de janeiro de 1995, como Presidente e Vice-Presidente ...

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse read by the First Secretary and signed at the session records that at 10:00 on 15 March 1990, before the National Congress in joint session in the Chamber's plenary, Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello and Itamar Augusto Cautiero Franco were solemnly invested under Article 78 of the Constitution in the offices of President and Vice-President of the Republic, respectively, for the period 15 March 1990 to 1 January 1995, and took the prescribed oath.

locator.item: Termo de posse dos Excelentíssimos senhores Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello e Itamar Augusto Cautiero Franco, nos cargos, respectivamente, de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The same termo recites that the two had been elected in the second round on 17 December of the previous year and certified ('diplomados') by the Superior Electoral Court on 30 December of that year.

locator.item: Termo de posse: 'diplomados, pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, a trinta de dezembro do mesmo ano'
